title: My Daily Routine
subtitle: Describing what you do every day — for English learners

sentences.en: I usually wake up at seven o'clock in the morning.
sentences.target: I usually wake up at seven o'clock in the morning.

sentences.en: First, I take a shower and get dressed for work.
sentences.target: First, I take a shower and get dressed for work.

sentences.en: Then I have a quick breakfast — coffee and toast.
sentences.target: Then I have a quick breakfast — coffee and toast.

sentences.en: I leave the house at eight and take the bus downtown.
sentences.target: I leave the house at eight and take the bus downtown.

sentences.en: I work from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon.
sentences.target: I work from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon.

sentences.en: At lunchtime, I usually eat a sandwich at my desk.
sentences.target: At lunchtime, I usually eat a sandwich at my desk.

sentences.en: After work, I sometimes go to the gym for an hour.
sentences.target: After work, I sometimes go to the gym for an hour.

sentences.en: I get home around seven and cook dinner for my family.
sentences.target: I get home around seven and cook dinner for my family.

sentences.en: In the evening, I like to read a book or watch a show.
sentences.target: In the evening, I like to read a book or watch a show.

sentences.en: I go to bed at about eleven o'clock at night.
sentences.target: I go to bed at about eleven o'clock at night.
